section_id_policy: checked-in opaque immutable ID assigned once by an explicit section index; not regenerated from headings, hashes, paths or line numbers after S1
initial_assignment: deterministic candidate IDs may seed S1; the checked-in index freezes identity before use
exact_binding: file hash + section hash + heading path + AST/span + order must all match; mismatch is typed fail-close and requires an explicit index migration
rename_or_edit_policy: preserve section_id in an explicit migration record while updating exact assertions; ambiguous split/merge gets new IDs and predecessor links
